context.question: Who will win the 2019 Lok Sabha elections?
context.setting: Voting runs 11 April–19 May 2019, with counting on 23 May. Incumbent Prime Minister Narendra Modi (BJP/NDA) seeks a second term; Rahul Gandhi leads the Congress-led opposition. The assessment is made before any votes are cast.

provenance.work: ANI via Business Standard, 'LS polls: Odds in PM Modi's favour, say clairvoyants', 30 March 2019
provenance.edition: ANI wire report (Business Standard AMP edition)
